analytical_method: UPLC-MS/MS, in-house validated method for NHDC in food
extraction_method: Solid food extracted from 0.5 g sample; water-methanol (1:1), sonication, cold precipitation, centrifugation, dilution, filtration

extraction_notes: Table 4 reports hard-candy NHDC concentration as 11 ± 10 mg/kg for 3 detections; the article states only one of three NHDC-positive samples was quantifiable, with two below LOQ. The reported category summary is retained as published; it is not represented as an exact concentration for a specific candy sample.
uncertainty_notes: The paper states values below LOQ were replaced with LOQ/2 when calculating means. Thus the mean and SD are partially censored and include imputation; only one sample was above LOQ. This is a market-food measurement summary, not a sample-specific result. Count this compound once, not once per sample.
